old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-3dpc","title":"SOS: alert node-IID extraction diverges from key-store derivation + spec 18.4.1 accounting key","description":"Security codereview of b7z9.121.1 (finding 1). C sos_post (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_server.c) extracts the SOS accounting/lookup key via alert_node_iid, which hex-parses chars 0-15 of the colon-separated IPv6 node string - producing bytes from the address PREFIX with 0xFF corruption at colon positions, NOT the canonical key-derived IID (SHA-512(pubkey)[0:8], U/L cleared) that lichen_key_store_put uses (coap_keys_store.c:394 validates pubkey-\u003eIID derivation). Consequence: lichen_key_store_get(node_iid) misses every realistically-pinned key, so the SOS verify path is dead-on-arrival in production. Separately, spec 18.4.1 mandates the rate-limit/seq accounting key be the full 16-byte origin IPv6 address and MUST NOT extract an IID. Also a C\u003c-\u003ePython wire divergence: Python node is 16 bare hex IID chars, C validate_node_id (sos_alert.c:314) requires 8 colon-separated groups. Fixing requires (a) deriving the accounting key from the VERIFIED pubkey (or full origin address per spec), (b) reconciling the C/Python node wire form, (c) the AddrForKey origin-address migration (b7z9.121.2). Out of scope for b7z9.121.1 (seq gate + per-origin limiter, which keys by the same node_iid the surrounding code already uses); tracked here.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-09-10T03:02:38.968443373Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-09-10T03:02:38.968443373Z","labels":["c","zephyr","apps","spec-gap","security"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-3dpc","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.121.1","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-09-10T03:02:39.138812828Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
